Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1222
Claimant:
Virginia Bell
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
11 Jan 2025
The claimant reported a side impact at a controlled intersection, with the claimant's vehicle struck on the driver's side
by another vehicle that entered from the cross street. The claimant said the claimant was in the vehicle and the driver
is named on the policy.
15 Feb 2025
Police attended the scene and confirmed the claimant was seated in the vehicle when it was struck. Two independent
witnesses were located and both described the collision in the same sequence the claimant gave.
13 Mar 2025
The other driver gave a statement that matches the claimant's account of the signal phase and the point of impact.
Scene photographs show the damage pattern lining up with the reported direction of force.
17 Mar 2025
The vehicle was inspected at the repair facility, and the damage to the driver's side panels, door and rear quarter is
consistent with the impact described. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records or from the repair
history provided.
19 Mar 2025
The claimant attended urgent care the same day with neck pain and stiffness, which the examining clinician recorded
as a strain. The injury is a good fit for the kind and force of a side impact of this type, and no prior injury to the neck or
upper back is known.
21 Apr 2025
The claimant was contacted by phone and again in person, and the account of the accident has stayed the same
each time, including the sequence of events and the position of the vehicles. The claimant is not represented by an
attorney and has been responsive to requests for records.
14 May 2025
A neighbor who was contacted during the investigation said they believed the vehicle showed body damage some
weeks before the reported collision. The neighbor could not give a firm date or describe the damage, so this
recollection is being noted and will be checked against the repair history and any available photographs.
6 Jun 2025
Treatment followed a usual course, with physiotherapy sessions tapering as the claimant's range of motion and pain
improved. The treating provider's notes show steady progress and a plan to discharge the claimant from active care
once goals are met.
14 Jul 2025
The neighbor's recollection was reviewed against the repair records and the photographs taken at the scene, and no
record supports earlier damage. Based on the evidence gathered, the claim is progresisng toward evaluation of the
neck strain with the treatment and recovery timeline noted.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
